Morale checks trigger at half losses or when a strong ally falls.

GMs: Roll a DC 15 Wisdom check for morale at half losses or a fallen ally; skip it and expect chaos.

Bookmark it before your players find the loophole. @bizzalgames70

Path of Wild Magic triggers random magical effects while raging.

DMs: Signal the Path of Wild Magic pivot by declaring your action economy shift from Magic Awareness to rage-induced chaos.

One ruling a day, no fluff. Follow @bizzalgames70.

Mighty Deeds of Arms require no saving throw or opposed roll.

Judges: Enforce that Mighty Deeds need no saving throw; just a hit and a Deed die of 3 or more.

Save this for your next session. Daily rulings: @bizzalgames70

Kraken is perfect for a playful encounter that can still punish bad habits.

GMs: Make them roll a DEX save DC 15 each round or watch their ship capsize in the Kraken's storm.

Hiding requires the DM to determine when circumstances allow it.

DMs: Clarify that hiding requires both cover and a successful Stealth check, not just a whim or wish.

Fly drops you mid-air if the spell ends unexpectedly.

Judges: Remind them Fly's spell check determines duration - cast it low to the ground unless they enjoy plummeting.

Send this to the rules-lawyer in your group. @bizzalgames70

GMs: Hand the Necklace Of Charm to the party's charisma-challenged member; their Charisma becomes 18, no questions asked.
